reading.body:
The District of Columbia's tracked 25 bills include only a small number that touch AI directly: an Artificial Intelligence Literacy in Education Act, a Surveillance Pricing Prohibition Act, and a Distribution of False Sexual Imagery Prohibition Act addressing non-consensual synthetic sexual images.

The majority of the list consists of routine District governance matters, board and commission confirmation resolutions, water authority contracts, and campaign finance rules, showing that most bills swept into this tracked set are only loosely or not at all related to artificial intelligence.

The false sexual imagery bill and the AI literacy in education bill represent the two most direct AI policy responses in this list, addressing synthetic media harms and AI education respectively as distinct legislative concerns.

The data does not indicate which of these bills passed, failed, or remain pending, nor does it include bill text beyond title and number, so the District's actual AI related legal framework is not established by this record.
